auth.verify.title: Confirm the SMS code
auth.verify.description: Send a six-digit code to {phone}. The code expires after 10 minutes.
auth.verify.sent: The code was sent. It can only be used once.
auth.verify.invalid: That code is incorrect, expired, or has already been used.
auth.verify.cooldown: Please wait one minute before requesting another code.
auth.verify.rateLimited: Too many codes were requested. Try again in one hour.
auth.verify.sendError: The SMS could not be sent. Try again shortly.
